entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. By means of the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the applicant has sought for a suitable direction to the Civil Judge (J.D.)/F.T.C., Court, Gautam Buddh Nagar, to decide the proceedings of Case No.501 of 2022, arising out of Case Crime No.154 of 2021, under Sections 498A,
323, 504, 406 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Mahila Thana, District- Gautam Buddh Nagar, within time stipulated by this Court, which is pending before the aforesaid court.

entities.text: Smt Poonam Singh vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is the informant of the aforesaid case, which is pending since the year 2021 and no progress has been made so far.
Learned counsel further submits that a direction may be issued to the concerned court to decide the aforesaid case within specific time frame.

4. In view of aforesaid, the learned Civil Judge (J.D.)/F.T.C., Court, Gautam Buddh Nagar, is directed to consider and decide the above-stated case expeditiously, preferably within a period of one year from the date of production of copy of this order before the court concerned, provided there is no legal impediment.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5. The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of accordingly.
